source.author: Arun Debray
source.title: Invertible phases for mixed spatial symmetries and the fermionic crystalline equivalence principle
source.method: Spin-c/Pin-c bordism, Adams spectral sequences, Anderson-dual equivariant phase homology
source.scope: Interacting Class A only, under the generalized-homology ansatz. Class D columns are not extracted. Includes independent intrinsic responses and neutral bosonic contributions.
source.independence_limit: Different mathematical method; v3 explicitly acknowledges revisions following comparison with Zhang-Ning-Qi-Gu2025. Not blind independence of the final tables.

limits: No full physical-to-solver generator dictionary is asserted.
No improper 3D E8 quotient is inferred from abstract factor multiplicities.
Cyclic n=1 is a specialization of the source's general formula.
A torsion bordism character and a free-response integer arise from different parts of the Anderson-dual universal coefficient sequence; raw bordism groups are not copied as phase groups.

rows.name: C1
rows.source_formula: Z^2 + Z_(2n) + Z_(n/2) for even n; Z^2 + Z_n^2 for odd n
rows.restriction_argument: For cyclic rotations, forgetting rotation restricts onto the two-integer intrinsic electronic response lattice; the finite kernel is the torsion subgroup. Setting e0=0 retains one free response integer. For reflection groups both uniform responses vanish. These are abstract subgroup types, not a dictionary for the solver's primitive roots or product convention.
